head: ba0a33091c1dad6c4cb00212de91498371e7dbd8
reviewType: Internal build-boundary review; no external expert
authorization: Root approved only existing WXT transform wiring, one pinned raw-data helper and its boundary test; no AI Proxy business, vendor, source-lock, budget, fixed-entry or runtime-permission changes in this step.

sourceLock.note: Unchanged from the earlier approved eight-key review; this transform step does not update it.

transformation.acceptedInput: Acorn-validated module containing one ExportDefaultDeclaration with a string Literal exactly equal to the byte-pinned source. No eval or executable module loading.
transformation.rejected: Raw data or original consumer drift, symlinks, different string content, expression exports, extra import/statements. Other targets, files and query variants receive no transformation.
transformation.removed: Only empty lines and ordinary comment blocks already ignored by the original consumer.
transformation.retained: Every effective rule in original order, complete original header including MPL, upstream source, VERSION, COMMIT and usage notices; entire copyright/license/permission/Mozilla/MPL notice blocks; ICANN and PRIVATE section markers.
transformation.sourceRetained: Complete original vendor file remains unchanged; no second data snapshot or runtime download.
transformation.byteLimit: These are raw-module measurements, not a final Browser bundle result.

verification.behavior: Both raw inputs were consumed by the same original domain.ts code compiled for a Node VM fixture. Every rule generated suffix and nested host cases, plus Unicode URL cases; output equality and explicit ICANN/PRIVATE/wildcard/exception/AI site/local-IP-credential rejection checks passed.
verification.sequence: All 10,336 raw rule tokens and their exact/wildcard/exception classes and WHATWG IDNA forms were compared item by item, not only by count.

independentReview.kind: Read-only inspection; did not run tests or build
independentReview.verdict: No veto found for execution/permission boundary, rule retention or original notice preservation.
independentReview.notes: Verified both real Git blobs, exact target/path/query, symlink/drift rejection, literal-only AST parsing, no eval/Function/VM/Host capability in helper, complete notice blocks and section retention. Test VM only executes original fixed consumer code.

evidenceLevels.browserBuild: Root-owned next formal build; not run by this reviewer

note: Existing source/provenance failures and other agents work remain intact. No full build, prior-suite rerun, commit, index mutation, Chrome interaction or package approval performed by this reviewer.
